subject: ela
intro: Eighth graders develop and strengthen writing by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well the purpose and audience have been addressed. Revising improves content and organization; editing fixes mechanics; both make the final piece stronger and better suited to its purpose.

items.prompt: What is the difference between REVISING and EDITING?

steps: Revising changes content and organization; editing fixes mechanics.
So revising improves ideas/structure; editing corrects grammar, spelling, punctuation.
solution.answer: Revising improves ideas/structure; editing fixes grammar, spelling, punctuation.

items.prompt:
A reader says your essay doesn't clearly address its PURPOSE.

Is fixing this revising or editing?

steps: Clarifying purpose changes content and focus.

items.prompt:
You fix three comma errors and a misspelling.

Is this revising or editing?
